requirements_summary: Primary workload: outbound SDR chat agents with live streaming and tool calls. Latency SLO: sub-200ms token delivery on average for real-time UX; tail latency targets p95 < 400ms. Throughput: 150-250 concurrent chats, peak bursts to 400 qps. Tool calling: CRM write (Salesforce), send email (Gmail SMTP/API), schedule meeting (Google Calendar/Office365). Need reliable retries/idempotency and clear audit logs for all actions. Model preferences: open/curated models OK but need predictable performance; want fallback variants when capacity constrained. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to trade some cost for latency guarantees. Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS, audit retention 1 year. Deployment path: Hosted API POC -> Dedicated reserved capacity if POC passes latency & stability checks.
demo_feedback: Streaming latency: generally good in NA region; p95 spikes during burst simulated tests. Tool-calling: ok in demo but experienced 2 failures on Salesforce write in single session (needs retry/backoff). SE recommended enabling automatic fallback to smaller models for non-critical steps and dedicated pool for high concurrency.
poc_plan: 2-week POC: hosted sandbox + test harness provided by Rev. Day 0-2: integration + smoke tests. Day 3-7: synthetic load (150-400 concurrent) measuring p50/p95/p99 token latencies. Day 8-12: end-to-end flow with Salesforce/Gmail/Calendar tool calls; check audit logs, idempotency. Day 13-14: review results, finalize pricing conversation for Dedicated if SLOs met.
